title: Onboard tesseract-7b-v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Alyssa Park
description: Onboard tesseract-7b v1.0 into the model registry. This PR adds model metadata (architecture, tokenizer, download URIs, license), performance profiles for common sequence lengths and batch sizes, and automates changelog entry generation for perf profile changes. Motivation: tesseract-7b is a community-verified 7B model with strong latency/cost tradeoffs on our kernels; we want a curated profile so hosted/dedicated deployments route to the optimal kernel/quantization. Changes: bump model metadata schema to include quantization_profile and preferred_kernels, add perf profiles under models/tesseract-7b/perf/, add a profile-validator CI job to validate profiles against a sample workload, update the model index and the onboarding docs, and add a changelog templating hook that creates a release note when profiles are published. See Linear ENG-4821 for rollout and canary plan. Checklist: [x] metadata schema bump, [x] perf profiles added, [x] profile validator + CI, [x] changelog automation wired, [ ] schedule canary deploy
